method.bit_rule: bit = pixel[r][c + 1] > pixel[r][c], row-major, MSB first
method.candidate_scope: every pair of clips with different source_cluster_id (a split-independent superset of the cross-split comparison)
method.frame_times: t_i = duration * (2i + 1) / 16 for i = 0..7 (evenly spaced, no endpoints)
method.pair_distance: minimum Hamming distance over all 8 x 8 frame pairs

rule: INDEPENDENT: similar but independently recorded, may cross splits. SHARED_SOURCE: confirmed shared or tightly derived recording; the two clusters are merged into one partition unit and the dataset is re-split. UNRESOLVED: a CROSS_SPLIT candidate not yet investigated; the freeze refuses. NOT_REQUIRED_SAME_SPLIT: a SAME_SPLIT candidate, reported as a diagnostic; it does not block the freeze and becomes UNRESOLVED if a re-split separates it.
